findings.current: At the end of the Great Cataclysm, an event later called Victory Day,
findings.defect: The draft calls the Great Cataclysm itself Victory Day rather than locating Victory Day at its end.
findings.rationale: The later name applies to the day of victory, not the entire cataclysm.
findings.replacement: Near the end of the Great Cataclysm, on what would later be called Victory Day,

findings.current: The Doppelganger had infiltrated humanity for more than simple betrayal or defection.
findings.defect: “For more than” suggests betrayal or defection was part of its purpose; the source rejects that explanation.
findings.rationale: Jin realizes it was carrying out Asmodeus’s order, not merely changing sides.
findings.replacement: The Doppelganger’s infiltration of humanity hadn’t been a simple act of betrayal or defection.
findings.source: 도플갱어가 인류 속으로 스며들었던 것은, 단순한 배신이나 전향(轉向) 따위가 아니었음을.

findings.current: The Skeleton King, like me, still trapped behind a translucent barrier after trying to attack, stared blankly at the sight.
findings.defect: “Trapped behind” turns a barrier that blocked an attack into one confining the Skeleton King.
findings.rationale: The source compares their thwarted attacks; it does not say the Skeleton King is trapped.
findings.replacement: The Skeleton King, whose earlier attempt to attack had been blocked by a translucent barrier just like mine, stared blankly at the sight.
findings.source: 앞서 공격을 시도했던 나와 별다를 것 없이, 반투명한 막에 가로막혀 있던 스켈레톤 킹이 그 광경을 멍하니 바라보았다.

findings.current: It passed as if skimming over the Golems moving without souls.
findings.defect: The spear appears merely to skim over the Golems, rather than cutting through them.
findings.rationale: 가로질렀다 describes the spear passing through the Golems; 스치듯 conveys how effortlessly it does so.
findings.replacement: It sliced through the soulless Golems as if barely grazing them.
findings.source: 영혼 없이 움직이는 골렘(Golem)들을 스치듯 가로질렀다.

summary: The draft largely preserves the scene, but several passages alter a historical reference, the Doppelganger’s motive, or the mechanics of the fight.
